ipProtection.title: IP Protection Pathways
ipProtection.subtitle: Review potentially applicable intellectual property protection routes for your Ayurveda innovation.
ipProtection.infoNote: The routes below represent possible IP protection categories. Relevance depends on your specific product, formulation, and jurisdiction. Status shown as "Not assessed" means the backend has not yet evaluated that route for this assessment.
ipProtection.routesSubtitle: Different forms of intellectual property may protect different aspects of an Ayurveda product, formulation, brand, appearance, creative material, or confidential know-how. Review the routes below based on your assessment context.

patent.name: Patent
patent.explanation: May protect qualifying inventions or technical innovations — such as novel processes, formulations, or delivery mechanisms — subject to applicable patentability requirements.

trademark.name: Trademark
trademark.explanation: May protect brand identifiers such as names, logos, labels, or distinctive marks used to distinguish your product in the marketplace.

gi.name: Geographical Indication (GI)
gi.explanation: May be relevant where the product qualifies for GI protection — i.e., where quality, reputation, or characteristics are linked to a specific geographical origin.

design.name: Industrial Design
design.explanation: May protect novel ornamental or aesthetic visual aspects of your product or packaging — such as unique bottle shapes, patterns, or packaging designs.

copyright.name: Copyright
copyright.explanation: Copyright protects original creative expressions fixed in a tangible form. It does not protect ideas, methods, or formulations.

tradeSecret.name: Trade Secret / Confidential Know-How
tradeSecret.explanation: Confidential formulation details, proprietary processes, or business information may sometimes be protected through confidentiality agreements and trade-secret practices where applicable.

plantVariety.name: Plant Variety Protection
plantVariety.explanation: May be relevant where the subject concerns a qualifying new, distinct, uniform, and stable plant variety developed through breeding or cultivation.

tk.name: Traditional Knowledge
tk.explanation: Documented traditional formulations from classical texts generally cannot be patented, but are protected as prior art and heritage.

ipProtection.sourceGroundedDesc: IP-SAKTI connects to Indian and international IP authorities and legal frameworks to ground its IP route analysis in verifiable sources.
